# E. coli infection
### GSE33341
```{r}
#E. coli: GSE33341 -----
filename = "GSE33341"
GSE33341 <- getGEO("GSE33341", GSEMatrix = TRUE) 
eset_mouse <- GSE33341[[1]]
eset_human <- GSE33341[[2]]

#Metadata ------
#Mouse
GSE33341_ecoli_mouse_metadata = eset_mouse %>% 
  pData() %>% 
  dplyr::select( 
    geo_sample = "geo_accession", 
    #Host
    subject_title = "title",
    subject_num = "replicate number:ch1",
    batch = "experimental batch:ch1",
    host_strain = "host strain:ch1",
    organism = "organism_ch1",
    age = "host age (yr):ch1",
    sex = "host gender:ch1", 
    #Pathogen
    pathogen = "pathogen:ch1",
    status = "infection status:ch1",
    site_infection = "anatomic site of infection:ch1",
    route_infection = "inoculum route:ch1",
    dosage = "pathogen   dosage cfu/g:ch1",
    timepoint = "time after infection (h):ch1",
    bac_strain = "bacterial strain:ch1"
    ) %>% 
  filter(pathogen %in% c("Escherichia  coli", "-")) %>%
  mutate(pathogen = if_else(pathogen == "Escherichia  coli", "escherichia coli", "none"),
         subject_id = paste0("Mouse_", host_strain, "_Animal", subject_num, "_Batch", batch),
         status = str_replace(status, "-", "Healthy"),
         condition = paste("Mouse", host_strain, timepoint, sep = "_"),
         comparison = paste0("Mouse_", host_strain, "_Batch", batch)) %>% 
  select(geo_sample, comparison, condition, subject_id, everything())

GSE33341_ecoli_mouse_metadata
```


```{r}
#Human
GSE33341_ecoli_human_metadata = eset_human %>% 
  pData() %>% 
  filter(`pathogen:ch1` %in% c("Escherichia coli", "-")) %>%
  dplyr::select( 
    geo_sample = "geo_accession", 
    #Host
    subject_title = "title",
    # subject_num = "replicate number:ch1",
    batch = "experimental batch:ch1",
    # host_strain = "host strain:ch1",
    organism = "organism_ch1",
    age = "host age (yr):ch1",
    sex = "host gender:ch1", 
    ethnicity = "ethnicity:ch1",
    #Pathogen
    pathogen = "pathogen:ch1",
    # status = "infection status:ch1",
    site_infection = "anatomic site of infection:ch1"
    # route_infection = "inoculum route:ch1",
    # dosage = "pathogen   dosage cfu/g:ch1",
    # timepoint = "time after infection (h):ch1",
    # bac_strain = "bacterial strain:ch1"
    ) %>% 
  mutate(site_infection = str_to_lower(site_infection),
         organism = "Human",
         pathogen = if_else(pathogen == "-", "Healthy", pathogen),
         status = if_else(pathogen == "Healthy", pathogen, "infected"),
         timepoint = "0",
         subject_id = if_else(pathogen == "Escherichia coli", 
                              paste0("Ecoli_human_", site_infection,"_",geo_sample), 
                              paste0("Healthy_human_", geo_sample)),
         site_infection = if_else(site_infection == "-", "none", site_infection),
         condition = subject_id) %>% 
  select(geo_sample, condition, subject_id, everything())

GSE33341_ecoli_human_metadata

#Unite metadata
GSE33341_ecoli_mouse_human_metadata = GSE33341_ecoli_human_metadata %>% 
  bind_rows(GSE33341_ecoli_mouse_metadata)

GSE33341_ecoli_mouse_human_metadata %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "GSE33341_ecoli_mouse_human_metadata.rds"))
```


```{r}
#Import
GSE33341_ecoli_mouse_human_metadata =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "GSE33341_ecoli_mouse_human_metadata.rds"))

#Get expression data -----
#Mouse
GSE33341_mouse_eset <- exprs(eset_mouse) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  select(GSE33341_ecoli_mouse_human_metadata %>% 
           filter(organism == "Mus musculus") %>% 
           pull(geo_sample)) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("probe_id") 

#Human
GSE33341_human_eset <- exprs(eset_human) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  select(GSE33341_ecoli_mouse_human_metadata %>% 
           filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
           pull(geo_sample)) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("probe_id")
```

Annotate genes
```{r}
#Annotate genes ------
#Mouse -----
#Annotate data and calculate log2fc
GSE33341_mouse_expression_metadata  = GSE33341_mouse_eset %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = 2:125,
               names_to = "geo_sample",
               values_to = "value_raw") %>% 
  inner_join(GSE33341_ecoli_mouse_human_metadata, 
             by = "geo_sample") 

#Get value from day 0 and calculate Log2FC
GSE33341_log2fc_sample = GSE33341_mouse_expression_metadata %>% 
  filter(organism == "Mus musculus",
         status == "Healthy",
         host_strain == "C57BL/6J",
         batch == "8") %>% 
  select(probe_id, comparison, batch, subject_num, day0_value_raw = value_raw) %>% 
  inner_join(GSE33341_mouse_expression_metadata %>% 
               filter(timepoint != "0",
                      host_strain == "C57BL/6J",
                      batch == "8"),
             by = join_by("probe_id", "comparison", "batch", "subject_num")) %>% 
  mutate(log2fc = value_raw - day0_value_raw)

#Check duplicates
GSE33341_log2fc_sample %>% 
  filter(subject_id == "Mouse_C57BL/6J_Animal1_Batch8",
         probe_id == "1415670_at")

```


```{r}
########### Filter and annotate probes -----
## Set up biomart
ensembl_mart <- useMart("ensembl")
ensembl_mart <- useDataset("mmusculus_gene_ensembl", mart = ensembl_mart)

## Get the MGI symbol
gene_id <- GSE33341_log2fc_sample$probe_id %>% unique()
# listAttributes(ensembl_mart)
#Annotate
annot <- getBM(
  attributes = c("affy_mouse430_2",
                 "ensembl_gene_id",
                 "entrezgene_id",
                 "mgi_symbol",
                 "description"),
  filters = "affy_mouse430_2",
  values = gene_id,
  mart = ensembl_mart)

#Gene lookup table
HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez = FIT.mouse2man::HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez %>% 
  rename(human_symbol = HGNC_symbol,
         mouse_symbol =MGI.symbol,
         HS.Entrez = Human.Entrez,
         MM.Entrez = Mouse.Ortholog) %>% 
  mutate(HS.Entrez = as.character(HS.Entrez),
         MM.Entrez = as.character(MM.Entrez))

#Filter genes with highest median expression
GSE33341_mouse_counts_log2_summary_annotated_probes = GSE33341_log2fc_sample %>% 
  group_by(probe_id) %>% 
  summarize(mean = mean(value_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
            median = median(value_raw, na.rm = T)) %>%  
  inner_join(annot %>% 
              rename(probe_id = affy_mouse430_2), 
            by = "probe_id") %>% 
  group_by(entrezgene_id) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>% 
  select(probe_id, entrezgene_id, mgi_symbol) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  
  #Filter probes from the original table
  inner_join(GSE33341_log2fc_sample, 
             by = "probe_id") %>% 
  
  #Annotate hgnc symbols
  inner_join(HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez %>% 
               clean_names() %>% 
               rename(mgi_symbol = mouse_symbol) %>% 
               select(mgi_symbol, human_symbol), 
             by = join_by("mgi_symbol")) 

#Filter human symbol by entrez
GSE33341_mouse_counts_log2_summary_annotated_probes = GSE33341_mouse_counts_log2_summary_annotated_probes %>% 
  #Filter entrez ids with the highest median
  inner_join(GSE33341_mouse_counts_log2_summary_annotated_probes %>%
               select(probe_id, entrezgene_id, human_symbol, value_raw) %>%
               group_by(human_symbol, entrezgene_id) %>%
               summarize(median = median(value_raw, na.rm = T)) %>% 
               ungroup() %>% 
               select(entrezgene_id) %>% 
               distinct(),
             by = "entrezgene_id") %>% 
  ungroup()

GSE33341_mouse_counts_log2_summary_annotated_probes %>% 
dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .by = c(human_symbol, timepoint, subject_id)) |>
  dplyr::filter(n > 1L)

GSE33341_mouse_counts_log2_summary_annotated_probes

#Save
GSE33341_mouse_counts_log2_summary_annotated_probes %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "GSE33341_mouse_counts_log2_summary_annotated_probes.rds"))
```

  distinct() %>%

  ungroup() %>% 
  select(human_symbol, subject_id, timepoint, log2fc) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  filter(human_symbol %in% c(GSE33341_mouse_symbol_dupes$human_symbol %>% unique())) %>% 
  arrange(subject_id, human_symbol) %>%

  pivot_wider(names_from = subject_id,
              values_from = log2fc)
